entities.summary: Jan Graubner is a Czech prelate of the Catholic Church who was Metropolitan Archbishop of Prague from 2022 to 2026. He was Metropolitan Archbishop of Olomouc in the Czech Republic from 1992 to 2022, after serving as an auxiliary there for two years.
